title: Probability
body_markdown:
There are 150 marbles in a box.
 60 of the marbles are red while the others are green and blue.
 A marble is chosen at random; and the probability of choosing a green marble is 7/30. 
 (a) Find the probability of choosing 
(i) a red marble.
(ii) a blue marble.
(b) A marble is chosen at random, observed; but not replaced. Another marble is then chosen and observed.
 Calculate the probability that one marble is red and the other is green.
